entities.summary: Vanessa Springora is a French publisher, writer and film director. She is the author of the memoir Consent, describing sexual abuse she experienced beginning at age 14 from the pedophile Gabriel Matzneff, then 49. The book became a bestseller and prompted changes to the French age of consent.
